remarks: Nestled in a wonderful Greenwich setting across from Mianus River Natural Park, this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 1.1-bath home offers the perfect blend of privacy, convenience, and comfort. Located in the highly sought-after Eastern Middle and North Mianus School districts, this home boasts large windows that capture scenic views, filling the space with natural light. The spacious backyard and patio offer the perfect setting for relaxing or entertaining. Inside, the bright and open layout creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. The lower level features 800+ sq. ft. of flexible space-ideal for a family room, playroom, home office, or gym. An attached garage provides easy access and ample storage. Move-in ready and available for immediate occupancy.
